name: Tilted Card

maxTilt.description: Maximum tilt on each axis, in degrees.

scale.description: Scale applied while hovered or focused.

perspective.description: 3D perspective set on the host, in px.

damping.description: Spring damping: 0 follows instantly, close to 1 is heavy lag.

glare.description: Brighten the edge closest to the viewer.

caption.description: Tooltip text that trails the cursor; no tooltip when null.

resetDuration.description: Ease-back-to-flat duration on leave, in ms.

a11y: Content order is unchanged; mount only wraps the existing children in .genui-tilted-card__inner.
If the host is focusable, keyboard focus gives the same static lift (scale) as pointer hover, with no directional tilt.
The caption is not the only way to get its information: the same text is also given through a visually hidden element linked with aria-describedby.
The glare and caption bubble are aria-hidden, decorative layers; they never enter the accessibility tree.
glareOpacity keeps a sane default cap so the glare layer does not wash out host text contrast.
